title: Universe classifier axes record v0.5.0
description: ADR-135. Successor to the 0.4.0 axes contract, and it separates one thing: what the model says ABOUT evidence from the evidence address itself. V2.5 through V2.7 fused them -- axis, passage_ref, span_ref and supported_claim sat in one required, length-bounded object, so an overlong claim destroyed an authentic span selection and a reproducible tier along with it. The V2.7 calibration lost a row exactly that way. Here the address is authoritative and strictly validated; the interpretation is optional, unbounded, and cannot fail the row. What does NOT change: the model still returns identifiers and never text, so evidence_quote, offsets and digest are absent from this contract and the pipeline derives them from the hash-bound packet. A non-string interpretation is still refused -- type discipline is uniform across every model-authored field, and 996 accepted evidence items across three completed runs produced no non-string value.

customer_market_orientation.description: Descriptive metadata only. The deterministic tier engine takes this as no input at all.

contradictions.description: Where the complete Item 1 packet qualifies or contradicts the non-authoritative admission context.

span_ref.description: A contiguous run of whole sentence units inside one displayed passage, named by the pinned span index. Pnnn:Snnn selects one unit; Pnnn:Snnn-Snnn selects a run in reading order. The model returns this identifier and no source text.

span_interpretation.description: MODEL-AUTHORED, non-authoritative. One short conclusion clause naming what this span establishes for its axis. Optional: omit it, or send null, rather than inventing one. Deliberately unbounded -- the pipeline records an annotation_status instead of refusing the row, and never edits, truncates or normalises what is sent. It is read by humans in the calibration review and reaches no tier: the tier engine conditions on six axes and this is not one.
